tei:div.tei:p: rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod ka)

ka bka' bab bzhi yi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar// kha dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa snyan grags lha'i rnga chen tshangs dbyangs kyi sgra brgya pa/ ga rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen gyi gsang ba'i rnam par thar*/ nga rgyal ba kun dga'i mtshan can gyi shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar nyams len bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun// ca rnam thar gyi zhu ba snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang*/ de'i zhus lan dkar chag ma zhes bya ba*/ cha rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku tshe'i smad kyi rnam thar mthong ba don ldan/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod kha) ka kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan/ kha rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos chen po dngos grub char 'bebs/ ga dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa dad ldan thar pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba*// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod ga) ka rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar phan bde'i 'byung gnas bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po/ kha rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar dngos grub kyi dga' ston/ ga rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar kha skong ngo mtshar 'od brgya'i bang mdzod dad 'dun yid kyi shing rta ngoms par byed pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nga rje karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen la bstod pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi 'dod 'jo// ca dwags po paṇa chen gsung rab mang thos pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'gro ba'i bla ma/ cha rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ ja rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs dam mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag chen mo dngos grub char 'bebs/ nya rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs dam mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gi nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag rin chen bang mdzod/

ta rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs dam mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gi nang gi dkar chag tha bka' bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rnam par dbye ba log rtog kun sel/ da sgrub brgyud rin po che'i khyad chos lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad kyi dris lan*/ na rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen la nang so rgya mtshos zhus pa'i sdom gsum gyi dris lan/ pa dge slong kun dga' shes rab la gdams pa'i sdom gsum dris lan/ pha sa dkar rnying gsum dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba snying po'i don gsal ba/ ba lcag ge dge slong rin chen bzang po la gdams pa'i zhus lan 'od kyi phreng ba/ ma mkhas grub chen po gangs dkar ras chen pas zhus lan/ tsa dpal ri bo che'i sgom chen mtsho skyes la gdams pa'i zhus lan mdo 'gag rin po che'i phreng ba/ tsha shel ma sgom chen la gdams pa'i zhus lan ma rig mun sel/ dza bande rin chen bzang po la snying nas gces par gdams pa/ wa khams kyi bla chen la gdams pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi khrid tshigs bcad ma// zha tsha chu kha nas rgya ston rtogs ldan la gdams pa/ za rtogs ldan 'ba' ral la gdams pa'i gsol 'debs/ 'a nā tha maṅga la gdams pa gegs sel gyi man ngag ya rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kong po rtogs ldan kun dga' rgyal po la gdams pa'i gegs sel man ngag rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod nga ) ka dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub don bsdus/ kha dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum gnad bsdus rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu'i rnam bshad/ ga dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' gnad kyi zhu don dri ma med pa'i sgron me/ nga dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dri lan 'od zer stong ldan/ ca dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/ cha phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba nyams su blang bde ba/ ja phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba'i gsal byed/

nya phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu skye dgu'i re skong zhes bya ba*/ ta phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid spyan snga ā nanda ratnas 'chug med du bsgrigs pa/ tha phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid zin/ da phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid lta ba'i mig 'byed/ na phyag chen chos drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rigs bdag ma*/ pa zab lam nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi zin bris/ pha zab lam chos drug gi lhan thabs sbas don kun gsal/ ba mos gus srog 'khor gyi dbang khrid zhal gdams kyis brgyan pa/ ma bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod ca ) ka dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud brtag pa dang po'i rnam bshad rin po che'i phreng ba/ kha dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa las rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi snyan brgyud zab don rgya mtsho/ ga dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i zin bris snying po'i don gsal ba'i me long*/ nga rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsan yig byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i dpal 'bar/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod cha) ka rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan skyes ma'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/ kha jo bo thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i sgom rim/ ga 'phags ma rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod/ nga gcod kyi zin bris gsal ba'i sgron me/ ca dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po sgrub pa'i las rim gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ cha bde mgon gyi las rim nyung bsdus/ ja bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs nor bu bsam 'phel/ nya bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i dbang chog rin chen phreng ba/ ta shis brjod kyi rim pa bcas so//
